query:
SELECT 
  vsr.id,
  vsr.userId,
  vsr.twinId,
  vsr.scenarioId,
  LEFT(vsr.userResponse, 50) as response_preview,
  u.name as user_name
FROM value_scenario_responses vsr
JOIN users u ON vsr.userId = u.id
ORDER BY vsr.id DESC
LIMIT 20;
